description: Basic end-to-end eval golden set for Mirae SIF PoC. Sources: ISID (regulatory truth) cross-checked against live portal platinumsif.miraeassetmf.co.in. NOTE 18-Jul: v1 was built from FAQ's SIF.docx which is STALE on 4 facts (exit load 30d->90d, min SIP 5k->50k, min SWP 5k->50k, accredited 1L->5L); corrected here. Categories: fact (exact numbers must match), descriptive (pattern match), colloquial (no 'SIF' keyword - tests scope pinning), trap (must refuse gracefully).
